first_yield_grid.parameters: Original Table1, explicitly selected p_at=100000Pa; all decimal strings exact
first_yield_grid.note: Verification grid, not exact Figure5–10 experiments or physical universal preparation

families.inputs: 18 explicit isotropic cases generated from first_yield_grid
families.oracle: Exact p*m/(3G) axial yield magnitude; constant e,p through elastic leg; full Cartesian stress
families.gate: Signed stress/state/yield-entry and precision budgets; no reference to candidate outputs

families.purpose: Mixed-volume elastic entry and domain boundary
families.inputs: Freeze exact valid compression/expansion/shear increments plus a predictor leaving domain after potential earlier yield
families.oracle: Existing exact elastic solution, independently rederived in Cartesian high precision; first-yield bracket
families.gate: Event bracket width and constitutive accuracy are separate budgets; unsupported domain path rejects unchanged

families.inputs: Use E01 parents; continuous compression/extension and fully sheared Mandel directions; freeze endpoint/sample grids and three or more refinement levels
families.oracle: Independent Cartesian continuous original-law solver with regular hardening products and fixed alpha_in, two precisions and independent step refinements
families.gate: Full-state curve accuracy AND convergence; residual alone cannot pass

families.inputs: Freeze d=0,Hbar>0 outward/inward/zero loading; d<0; Hbar<=0 at d=0; Hbar+dE=0; p<=0; e boundary; nondeviatoric histories
families.oracle: Source-located symbolic branch expectations and exact supplied state bytes
families.gate: Declared rejection status plus complete unchanged incoming layout; zero-step no drift

families.inputs: Retain nonzero loaded histories; successful trial A, rejected trial B after accepted internal work, repeat A; serialize/restart at a prepared parent
families.oracle: Immutable parent bytes and independent successful-state reference
families.gate: Exact parent rollback/replay and separately bounded response accuracy

families.inputs: Freeze elastic radial-stress and zero-volume prescribed-q examples, plastic control paths, failed outer trial, smooth-branch directional perturbations
families.oracle: Analytical elastic finite-residual solution plus independent source trajectories/control solve
coverage: outer control residual distinct from material residual
families.gate: No complete-update tangent claim from residual AD; smooth tangents require separate freeze, otherwise mark unsupported

families.purpose: Parent-reset variant only, contingent D07 alternative
families.inputs: Freeze proportional cycle, nonproportional shear rotation, nested reversals, guard-zero neighbors, caller split vs unsplit, failed reset transaction
families.oracle: Independent explicit parent guard/transaction model; canonical source oracle only after 1986 mapping
coverage: no reset accumulation in outer controls
families.gate: Variant identity first; no false partition-invariance requirement or canonical equivalence

families.inputs: All frozen eligible cases plus explicit initialization export/import/restart and failed-request recovery
families.oracle: Independent equations first; cross-backend comparisons second; actual C-ABI package
families.gate: All eligible backend requests pass original accuracy/rejection policy; packaging is not scientific admission

must_freeze_before_candidate: reviewer-approved source corrections and variant scope
exact binary64 controls versus intended decimal controls
initial/prepared state bytes and parameter units
oracle algorithm, event convention, two precision levels and precision adequacy
complete sample grid and refinement partitions
per-channel absolute and relative accuracy budgets with units/scales
constitutive residual and outer control budgets separately
event bracket and branch-boundary classification policy
derivative claim and smooth-branch step/adequacy policy
assessor corruption matrix and failure retention
available_without_new_engine_feature: parent_increment reset for separately named variant
conditional_generic_design_only_if_requi: Located yield/domain/reversal events need a separately approved event lifecycle contract; no source-derived canonical requirement demonstrated yet
Complete update tangent through reset/events is not exposed; do not substitute inner residual AD
